facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: energy isolation failure on PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 30 March 2020 an incident occurred on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
